lead.question: 阿尔弗雷德大帝乔装潜入丹麦军营，究竟刺探到什么制胜的关键？
lead.warmup: 公元九世纪，丹麦人（维京人）大举入侵英格兰。威塞克斯国王阿尔弗雷德一度退守阿塞尔纳沼泽，军队所剩无几；敌人却在切本哈姆扎营过冬，骄横松懈。陷入绝境的国王竟只身乔装，潜入敌营刺探虚实——这场以智取胜的谍报行动，正是本课的精彩之处。
goals: 掌握 espionage、spy、minstrel、monarch、Saxon 等本课核心词汇。
理解并运用过去完成时，表达'过去的过去'。
识别并使用被动语态（were collected 等结构）。
掌握定语从句关系代词 who / that 的用法，能复述阿尔弗雷德的谍报经过。
lead.summary: 课文讲述阿尔弗雷德大帝的传奇：他熟记吟游歌手的歌谣，乔装成歌手携竖琴混入古瑟罗姆的丹麦军营，发现敌军纪律松弛、沉溺安逸，断定其不适合持久战、军需全靠临时抢掠。于是他改用骚扰战术拖着敌人周旋，断其补给，不到一个月便迫使丹麦人投降。过去完成时与被动语态，更凸显这场谍报的非凡。
lead.tips: 注意 the Danes（丹麦人）是复数，谓语须用 were，不可写成 was；espionage 为不可数名词，前面不加 a。

questions.q: What important thing did King Alfred learn when he penetrated the Danish camp of Guthrum?
questions.zh: 阿尔弗雷德大帝潜入古瑟罗姆的丹麦军营后，了解到什么重要情况？
questions.a: He learned that the Danes were no longer fit for prolonged battle, and that their commissariat had no organization but depended on irregular raids.
questions.aZh: 他了解到丹麦人已不再适应持久作战，其军需供应毫无组织，只靠临时抢掠维持。
questions.hint: 答案见课文 'But Alfred had deduced that the Danes were no longer fit for prolonged battle...' 一句。

questions.q: How did Alfred disguise himself to enter the Danish camp?
questions.zh: 阿尔弗雷德如何乔装进入丹麦军营？
questions.a: He disguised himself as a wandering minstrel, and his harp was his passport.
questions.aZh: 他扮成流浪的吟游歌手，以竖琴作为通行证。
questions.hint: 见 'disguised as a minstrel' 及 'their harp was their passport'。

questions.q: Why were wandering minstrels welcome everywhere in those days?
questions.zh: 当时浪迹天涯的吟游歌手为什么到处受欢迎？
questions.a: Because they were not fighting men, and their harp was their passport.
questions.aZh: 因为他们不是作战人员，竖琴就是他们的通行证。
questions.hint: 见 'They were not fighting men, and their harp was their passport.'

questions.q: What did Alfred notice about the Danish camp at Chippenham?
questions.zh: 阿尔弗雷德在切本哈姆的丹麦军营里注意到了什么？
questions.a: He noticed that discipline was slack: the Danes had the self-confidence of conquerors and their security precautions were casual.
questions.aZh: 他注意到丹麦军纪律松弛，他们以征服者自居，安全措施马马虎虎。
questions.hint: 见 'He noticed at once that discipline was slack...'。

questions.q: Why could this episode be called 'a unique epic of royal espionage'?
questions.zh: 为什么这段历史堪称'王室谍报活动中最精彩的篇章'？
questions.a: Because a king personally acted as a spy, and the intelligence he gathered let a tiny force defeat a far larger Danish army.
questions.aZh: 因为一国之君亲自充当间谍，凭借搜集到的情报，以寡敌众击败了远比自己强大的丹麦军队。
questions.hint: 结合全文主旨与末句 'royal espionage' 的评价作答。

exercises.q: 汉译英：阿尔弗雷德大帝曾亲自充当间谍。
exercises.a: Alfred the Great acted his own spy.
exercises.note: act one's own spy 意为亲任间谍

exercises.q: 填空：While his little army gathered at Athelney, the king set out to ______ the camp of Guthrum.
句型转换（改被动）：They collected women as well as food and drink.
exercises.a: Women as well as food and drink were collected.
exercises.note: be + 过去分词，主语为复数

exercises.q: 填空：Alfred ______ (learn) many of their ballads in his youth.
exercises.note: 过去完成时表更早的动作

exercises.q: 填空：Guthrum, ______ commanded the Danish invaders, had settled at Chippenham.
exercises.note: 非限制性定语从句用 who

exercises.q: 改错：Alfred had deduced that the Danes was no longer fit for prolonged battle.
汉译英：这一幕历史堪称王室谍报活动中的精彩篇章。
exercises.a: The episode could reasonably serve as a unique epic of royal espionage.
exercises.note: serve as 充当；espionage 谍报

quiz.q: 本课标题'王室谍报活动'对应的英文是？
options: Royal Espionage
Royal Minstrel
Royal Conquest
Royal Palace

quiz.q: 'Alfred the Great acted his own spy' 一句的意思是？
options: He hired spies to work for him.
He himself served as a spy.
He was captured by a spy.
He wrote a book about spies.
quiz.note: act one's own spy 亲自充当间谍

quiz.q: 下列哪一句使用的是被动语态？
options: They collected women as well as food.
Alfred did not risk open battle.
Women as well as food were collected.
Hunger assailed the Danish army.
quiz.note: be + 过去分词构成被动

quiz.q: 下列哪一句使用了过去完成时？
options: Alfred stayed in the camp a week.
His patrols halted the raiding parties.
He was constantly on the move.
Alfred had deduced that the Danes were unfit.
quiz.note: had + 过去分词表更早动作

options: A battle lasting a long time.
A short, sudden skirmish.
A battle fought at night.
A peaceful agreement.

quiz.q: 面对丹麦人的进攻，阿尔弗雷德采取的战术是？
options: He met the Danes in open battle.
He harried the enemy and avoided open battle.
He paid the Danes to withdraw.
He gave up and fled to Athelney.
